## Autumn Yoga Retreat with Ehud Neuhaus
ALGARVE, PORTUGAL  
OCTOBER 31th – NOVEMBER 5th 2025

A few immersive days of yoga, stillness and connection  
Explore a functional approach to yoga, daily Yang & Yin practices, meditation and philosophy workshops

### What to expect
- Functional approach to yoga: honor uniqueness in all aspects of practice, daily vigorous Yang movement, quiet Yin time and meditation
- Daily practice & meditation: 2 daily classes (Yang and Yin), morning meditation, workshops on philosophy
- Nourishment & relaxation: 3 daily plant-based meals, sauna and hot tub under the open sky
- Workshops: two afternoons diving into yoga philosophy

### The Facilitator
Ehud Neuhaus  
Practising yoga 20+ years, teaching since 2014  
Assisted Anat Geiger and Marcel van de Vis Heil in Functional Yoga Teacher Training since 2013  
Studied with Paul and Suzee Grilley (Yin Yoga)  
Founded the online platform The Fat Yogis with Anat and Marcel
